root_cause: The original Netlify release incident #5241 remained open after an independently proven exact-SHA production rollout. The authenticated Powerhouse delivery portal only displayed a synthesized release-status card, not the existing original incident state or its unresolved full-build phase diagnostic. Without the provider issue readback, a live website could be mistaken for closed root-cause learning.

evidence.source: GitHub issue #5241 and canonical authenticated Powerhouse observability API; portal continues reading no separate error registry

prevention_rule: For every original production release incident, the existing admin portal must show source-backed issue state separately from exact-SHA LIVE status. Missing GitHub issue / unverified manifest must fail closed. A green deployment cannot erase historical unresolved root cause, regressions or measured commercial outcomes.
